title: Read Carefully If You Have A Smaller Dog
text: The items included in this box were in no way appropriate for dogs under 10 pounds. I guess I had temporarily lost my mind when I ordered them or the description was not clear on this point. Whole pigs ears, braids 6” long and 3” wide, up to 1” thick. Even my larger dog, 8lbs. , could not chew on this comfortably. I had to use a thin, sharp knife to hack apart all but one piece in this box. I was very disappointed. The good thing that came from this purchase is I now know of other items they enjoy that can be purchased at a smaller size.
